help:
usage: domain-memory [-h] command ...

Initialize, validate, or assess a file-backed Domain Registry.

positional arguments:
  command
    readiness           Assess project readiness
    probe               Report Registry health
    lookup              Search an asset
    resolve-terms       Resolve vocabulary
    get-context         Retrieve a Context model
    get-record          Retrieve a record
    dependents          Follow a record's relations
    brief               Brief a change or a record
    analyze-boundary    Inspect a boundary
    boundary-impact     Find boundaries a change touches
    validate            Validate the Registry
    coverage            Report modelling gaps
    verify-evidence     Verify citations
    verify-sources      Verify selected sources
    verify-audit        Verify audit trail
    reconcile-audit     Reconcile audit trail
    refresh-indexes     Rebuild concept indexes
    cite                Build an evidence citation
    recite              Re-cite one changed citation
    relocate-evidence   Re-cite evidence after a move
    upsert-candidate    Add or revise a candidate
    retract-candidate   Withdraw a candidate
    promote-candidate   Put a candidate into a draft proposal
    harvest             Prove and package harvested rules
    discard-harvest     Withdraw a Change Package that is not applied, written
                        by harvest or by hand
    init-change-package
                        Start a Change Package
    validate-change-package
                        Validate a Change Package
    submit-proposal     Submit for review
    record-test-result  Record a test result
    record-approval     Record human approval
    verify-proposal     Verify test attestations
    rebase-proposal     Restamp a stale proposal on the current Registry
    ship-package        Attest, finalize and apply a verified package
    supersede-proposal  Retire a proposal
    list-proposals      List the Change Packages
    quality-gates       Find the repository's own checks
    counterfactual      Break one protection and restore it
    discover-sources    Map repository sources
    init-domain-memory  Start a Registry from human choices: the entry point
    confirm-sources     Confirm the selected sources
    refine-sources      Focus selected sources
    refresh-sources     Re-snapshot the selected sources
    refresh-listing     Refresh the discovered listing
    recover-registry-update
                        Recover an interrupted update
    demote-local-reviews
                        Withdraw local reviewed status
    redraft-proposal    Redraft a retired proposal
    export              Read the whole Registry from another tool
    change-coupling     See which modules change together
    compare-registry    Score an extracted Registry
    harvest-candidates  Harvest a scratch extraction
    governance-readiness
                        Report what governance still needs
    init-signing-key    Prepare a signing identity
    amend-policy        Change governance fields
    install-git-hitl-hook
                        Enforce signatures on push
    install-pre-commit-hook
                        Check staged citations on commit
    verify-git-governance
                        Check commit signatures
    validate-policy     Check a policy before adopting it
    verify-scm-attestation
                        Check SCM evidence alone
    audit-attestations  Audit past attestations
    scan-secrets        Scan for secrets
    validate-contract   Check a contract schema file
    mcp-serve           Serve the read commands to a host over MCP

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Everyday commands: readiness, probe, lookup, resolve-terms, get-context, get-record, dependents,
  brief, analyze-boundary, boundary-impact, validate, coverage, verify-evidence, verify-sources,
  verify-audit, reconcile-audit, refresh-indexes, cite, recite, relocate-evidence, upsert-candidate,
  retract-candidate, promote-candidate, harvest, discard-harvest, init-change-package,
  validate-change-package, submit-proposal, record-test-result, record-approval, verify-proposal,
  rebase-proposal, ship-package, supersede-proposal, list-proposals, quality-gates, counterfactual.

Advanced commands: discover-sources, init-domain-memory, confirm-sources, refine-sources,
  refresh-sources, refresh-listing, recover-registry-update, demote-local-reviews, redraft-proposal,
  export, change-coupling, compare-registry, harvest-candidates, governance-readiness,
  init-signing-key, amend-policy, install-git-hitl-hook, install-pre-commit-hook,
  verify-git-governance, validate-policy, verify-scm-attestation, audit-attestations, scan-secrets,
  validate-contract, mcp-serve.
